Agent: Dirac, native handle 01a18bb7-43e2-7901-9e9d-bce6a68eb63d; requested Sol Web High. Source: completion notification in originating chat during ZIP packaging. Root has not independently verified this newly received audit. No PC files were modified by worker.

Worker verdict: threshold e > sqrt(2*pi*sqrt(3))*sqrt(n-1) does not alone exclude degree <=2 or force a diameter-anchored 3-core. Requested Halley manuscript was absent, so its exact wording could not be certified.
Every triangle-free penny graph is 2-degenerate (Eppstein); ordinary 3-core empty. An anchored residual can retain low-degree anchors. Diameter endpoints are strictly exposed hull vertices; a <= h <= pi*D_n <= sqrt(2*pi*sqrt(3))*sqrt(n-1). An e>h conclusion is far weaker than minimum degree 3.
Worker gives exact n=8 regular unit-side heptagon plus inward unit-equilateral apex: 9 contacts > threshold 8.728..., six degree-two vertices; exact globally minimal diameter by Bezdek-Fodor. This example has a triangle and only refutes a threshold implication lacking triangle-freeness. Moving interior apex toward center removes two contacts and retains exact diameter, giving the known finite triangle-free optimizer.
Worker separately gives vertically expanded 25-site triangular lattice patch: n=25, e=19, diameter squared 40603/1600, triangle-free disjoint horizontal paths. It meets threshold and standard diameter upper bound but is provably NOT globally optimal (undo expansion gives diameter 5). This only refutes the counting inference.
Exact anchored peeling budget: e(G)<=2(n-a)+e(G[A]); for convex-position triangle-free anchors, e(G[A])<=floor((3a-4)/2). The O(sqrt(n)) threshold cannot violate this 2n-O(a) budget. Low-degree local movement leaves untouched diameter pairs at D_n, so it yields another optimizer rather than strict descent. No eventual theorem or infinite global counterfamily established.

Root reconstructed algebra; independent referee and historical novelty still pending. This is an auxiliary universal diameter estimate, not a unit-triangle proof.
- Wave108_1004 KKT/rank inequality b+d >= 2n-2-e, combined with Eppstein triangle-free contact bound gives b+d >= 1.64945 sqrt(n)-O(1). Missing strong all-global upper bound on b+d.
- Wave108_1003 discharging requires choosing a triangulation containing all unit Gabriel edges. An arbitrary triangulation does not suffice.
- Exact flexible n=8 optimizers provide finite exceptions only. Jacobian rank assertions awaiting independent audit.
- Claimed 2026 preprints are unverified source-specific claims, not accepted solutions.
